status.en: 3 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Bangui, Bambouti and Arsi.
status.nb: 3 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Bangui, Bambouti og Arsi.

summary.en: Armed clashes continue in Bangui among government forces, former Séléka rebels, Anti-balaka militias, Russian Wagner troops and Africa Corps, while regional forces struck ISWAP positions in the Lake Chad basin, killing senior leader Abu Zubiru and 15 others. Chad is now hosting hundreds of thousands of Sudanese refugees, extending the regional humanitarian crisis, and children of Darfur refugees are growing up in the same camps. The CAR war crimes court is facing collapse, threatening accountability for past atrocities. Niger has accused Chad of a deadly drone attack that killed two civilians, with France alleged to have supported the strike. 246 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
